cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The frozen devline test metadata named tests/test_notebook_acceptance_evidence.py, but the live repository file is tests/test_notebook_evidence.py.
impact: The frozen metadata contains one stale test path; the live notebook evidence test was run explicitly and no gate was skipped.
lesson: Resolve every frozen test path with rg --files before starting a formal devline.

cause: The focused P7 acceptance, witness, and Notebook evidence regression completed after the trust-boundary and legacy-recovery changes.
impact: 83 focused tests passed; Notebook evidence remained in scope.
lesson: Keep witness trust and explicit legacy migration under the focused QA gate before broader release checks.

cause: Behavior-changing mutations were applied to witness signature, missing-verifier, durable-chain, expiry, trust-label, legacy-control, timestamp, and challenge-output guards, then restored.
impact: Each targeted guard produced a real red assertion when behavior was removed; no no-op file-only mutation was accepted.
lesson: A mutation must bypass later guards or use a validly signed altered payload so its own behavior is proven.

cause: The agent-terminal full gate cannot apply macOS sandbox-exec containment; affected tests fail with the host error sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted.
impact: The backend reported 5405 passed, 20 containment-related failures, 5 skipped, and 1 xfailed; golden/invariants and frontend Vitest passed, so host-terminal full-gate acceptance remains NOT VERIFIED.
lesson: Run the release gate in the host terminal when containment-sensitive evidence is required; do not weaken sandbox tests to satisfy an agent sandbox.

cause: The first two formal devline start attempts used invalid tag spellings and were rejected before any implementation state was changed.
impact: The third start used the normalized hyphenated line ID and created the frozen Context Pack; no code or ledger bytes were modified by the rejected attempts.
lesson: Validate formal identifiers against the live CLI contract before starting a development line.

cause: The QA trust boundary and explicit legacy recovery path are implemented and focused-verified; the only remaining gate concern is the external host-terminal containment boundary.
impact: The coordinator is fail-closed for missing witness verification and old ledgers require explicit immutable migration; local code does not claim human identity proof.
lesson: Complete the implementation line without collapsing external browser-witness or host-containment evidence into local test status.
